m: The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and finds a tiny *servant* polishing every seashell on the sand. She blows her whistle, and now the *servant* fans her, brings lemonade and carries her towel. By sunset the Lifeguard has six of them and is too lazy to swim: being the **servant** of your own **servant** is hard work.

The {Lifeguard} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Museum}, where a *lying man* on a display plinth suddenly sits up. He swore to polish every exhibit tonight, so he slides *back and forth* on his socks, buffing dinosaur bones. At dawn he flops back down, promise **fulfilled**. The Lifeguard claps: a man who will **fulfil** his word even while lying down.

The {Jockey} rides his horse down into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} as *water drops* plink from the ceiling. The puddle swells, the river **rises**, and he aims a *stretched bow* straight up and fires himself to safety. The flood keeps **rising** after him, lifting planes off the floor like rubber ducks.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} when a *pheasant* lands on her head, swallowing a beam of *light*. It glows so **brilliant** that ships at sea steer by it and moths form a queue. The Yogi opens one eye, sighs, and puts on sunglasses: enlightenment was never meant to be this **brilliant**.

The {Ninja} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} and meets a *clown* blocking the stairs. A *helping hand* shoots out of the wall and **twists** the clown into a balloon animal, nose honking. Then it **twists** the Ninja too, so she leaves in a knot, still trying to look mysterious.

The {Tailor} stitches a tablecloth on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion}, but a heap of *soil* keeps piling up step by step. Out of the heap rises a raised **altar**, and a fluffy *cloud* settles on top to be worshipped. The Tailor drapes his cloth over the **altar** and kneels, a little confused, in front of the weather.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} reaches for an old rotary telephone. A giant *helping hand* grabs the **dial** and spins it so fast that the whole *launch pad* beneath the fort ignites. Every time the Baker **dials** a number, a doughnut rockets into the sky.

The {Wizard} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} into muddy *water drops* where a *dancer* is twirling barefoot. Wherever her toes splash, the soil turns **fertile**: tomatoes pop up, pumpkins swell, sunflowers smack the Wizard in the face. Soon the dungeon is the most **fertile** vegetable patch in the kingdom.

The {Hunter} bursts up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *meeting* of bored patients is stuck. He hands each a strand of *silk thread*, and they start **drawing** pictures in the air with it: a horse, a rocket, the receptionist's angry face. Before the doctor calls anyone, the whole wall is covered in thread **drawings**.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and finds a *lumberjack* in a bathrobe, swinging an axe at a potted palm. TIMBER! He **cuts down** the palm, the bamboo screens and the coat stand. The Firefighter sprays him with a hose, but he keeps on **cutting down** towels like trees.

The {King} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} holding an *overflowing bowl* of hot soup that keeps spilling onto his crown. Courtiers shovel *soil* onto his feet so he cannot run. He must **endure** it: the heat, the drips, the itchy dirt. He grits his teeth and announces that a true king can **endure** anything, except perhaps more soup.

The {Pirate} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and finds a *standing person* holding a *fortune stick* like a tray. 'Your fortune, sir, says I am your **servant**.' The Pirate hands over his parrot, his boots and his wet socks. The **servant** carries them all, bowing on every step, without dropping the fortune stick.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} building a *city wall* out of flowerpots. On each pot she paints the surname **Guo**, until the whole town reads like a family name tag. A passing pigeon is renamed Mr **Guo** and stamped with it too.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut faces a hungry storm god. To save his flock he offers up his *cow*, which walks forward wearing a *bird nest* as a crown. It is a great **sacrifice**. The god sniffs the cow, takes only the bird nest, and the Shepherd weeps anyway at his noble **sacrifice**.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} is attacked by a *skeleton* leading a *thousand ants*, all carrying coins. She juggles faster and faster, bowling pins flying, until every last ant is flicked into the sea and the skeleton falls apart. Enemies **annihilated**. She bows: total **annihilation**, and not a single coin dropped.

The {Magician} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} into a dark *soil* pit under a red *sunset*. He waves his wand and up rises a stone **tomb** with his own name carved on it. Furious, he pulls a rabbit from the **tomb**, then a dove, then his own hat, insisting he is not dead yet.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and lands beside a *door* where a *sparrow* sits with a little CV in its beak. She **hires** it on the spot to guard the door. By noon she has **hired** forty sparrows, each with a tiny badge, all asking for lunch breaks.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and finds a farmer in a *shed* who is offered a bribe for *two sheaves* of wheat. He pushes the bags of coins away and charges one coin, the fair price. Everyone gasps: an **honest** man in a money exchange! The Lifeguard hangs a medal on him that says **HONEST**.

The {Cheerleader} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut, where a *big man* is *carving* words into a surfboard with a pocketknife. It is a **contract**: whoever sits on the board must cheer for him forever. She signs it with a pom-pom, and the **contract** grows legs and runs into the sea.

The {Pirate} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} finds his treasure map torn into a hundred bits. A *helping hand* lays down *linked rails*, and a toy train carries the scraps along while he **pieces** them **together**. The map is **pieced together** at last, but it only shows the way to the Inn's kitchen.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} catches a monkey stealing bananas. A drumbeat starts and a *march* of soldier ants parades up the steps, each holding a tiny *heart* sign. To **punish** the thief, they make him march with them all day. That is how the jungle **punishes**: with endless, cheerful parades.

The {Jockey} sprints across the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} after a runaway sausage. A *helping hand* shoots out of a chimney and **grabs** his *foot* instead. He topples, reaches out wildly, and **grabs** the sausage just before it leaps off the edge.

The {Firefighter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool}, and the water is on fire. She drags a huge *cabinet* *back and forth* across the surface until its doors swing open and **cover** the flames like a lid. Steam hisses. The pool is **covered** so well that the ducks now walk on the cabinet.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Water Park} holds a *dustcloth* in one hand and a *standing knife* in the other. He **brushes** off the slides so hard they squeak, then **brushes** his moustache with the knife's bristly handle. Kids slide down shining like greased penguins.

The {Juggler} on the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} spots a burglar with a *strong arm* sneaking toward the *exit* sign, stuffing yeti fur into a sack. 'Stop! You can't **rob** a yeti!' The yeti wakes, and the **robber** ends up juggled up and down the stairs along with her pins.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and offers a *woman* *two sheaves* of hay as payment. She holds her nose: she **dislikes** hay, **dislikes** sheep, and especially dislikes shepherds who smell of them. She flicks the hay back down the stairs one straw at a time.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Water Park} plants one seed, and a giant **melon** bursts out of the slide. It rolls down the tube, scattering swimmers, and splashes into the wave pool. Now everyone floats on slices of *melon*, and the lifeguards sell **melon** juice by the bucket.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} has walked the flock up the mountain all day. A huge *question mark* bends over him like a deckchair, and he lets out an enormous *yawn* that echoes off the ice. 'Time to **rest**?' He curls into the question mark and **rests**, while the sheep snore around him.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} uses her drill to **carve** a statue out of a block of cheese. A *sparrow* pecks the wires of an electric *circuit* to power the drill. Sparks fly, and she **carves** a perfect cat that immediately meows for milk.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} and is locked behind a giant *gate*. Nothing happens. No rides, no music, just his *heart* ticking slowly. He is so **bored** he pulls out one rabbit, then sends it back. Even the rabbit looks **bored**.

The {Robot} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} finds a fluffy *hatchling* zooming around on a tiny *ski*, crying for food. It opens a hatch in its chest and pours out a jet of warm **milk**. The hatchling skis through puddles of **milk** and burps happily.

The {Chef} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swan Pond} holding a giant skewer. Splash! He **strings together** a fish, a lily pad, a frog and a confused swan into one long *kebab*. The swan honks to be let off, and the Chef **strings** on two more for balance.

The {Wizard} on the {Staircase} of the {Spa} hands a *woman* in a mud mask a glowing *jade tablet*. Poof! It turns into a gurgling **baby** wrapped in a fluffy spa towel. The **baby** grabs the Wizard's beard and won't let go, laughing every time he squeaks.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} has to **hand in** her homework, but it is tangled in *silk thread* and full of *sparkle* glitter. She juggles it up the stairs and **hands** it **in** to the teacher, a fat tabby cat who sneezes glitter everywhere.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swan Pond} with a huge *mouth* painted on his megaphone. He **calls** the swans for a *makeover*: lipstick, wigs, feather boas. Each time he **calls**, another swan glides in, fluffing itself up like a movie star.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} in a headstand. The prize, a *winner's purse* stuffed with a golden *shell*, hangs from the ropes. Her opponent tires out just watching her balance. She **wins** without throwing a punch, and the crowd chants '**Win**! **Win**!' as she bows upside down.

The {Lifeguard} on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} watches a *convoy* of tiny trucks drive up the steps, each loaded with pond *grass*. At the top they dump it all into a bucket, and a pink **lotus** blooms with a pop. Customers swap their coins for **lotus** petals instead.

The {Baker} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa}, slips on wet tiles, and lands on a *saddle* strapped to a bad-tempered **tyrant**. It is raining indoors, buckets of *rain* that the **tyrant** commands to fall on anyone who dares relax. The Baker rides him around the spa yelling until the clouds give up.

The {Tailor} on the {Staircase} of the {Tower} finds a *tree* growing straight out of the steps. Its fruit falls and lands on its *cracked shell*, splitting open to reveal a juicy **peach**. She sews every **peach** a tiny coat to stop them bruising.

The {Tailor} in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} has a mountain of stock that won't fit anywhere. A *soothing hand* pats him on the head, then rearranges every box until they fit perfectly. 'There. Is that **suitable**?' It is perfectly **suitable**. The hand pats him again, and he purrs.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} onto a creaking *sickbed* where an *elder* lies. The old man is so **thin** he slips through the gaps in the slats and floats up like a kite. The Sheriff ties him to a fishing rod so the **thin** fellow doesn't blow away.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} wants shade for her patients. A *helping hand* ties bundles of *thatch* together and starts to **put up** a hut, while she holds the poles with dental floss. The hut is **put up** in seconds, and everyone opens wide for a check-up in the shade.

The {Firefighter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} as a *runner* sprints past waving a *fortune stick*. 'It says you must **go to** the party at once!' The Firefighter swims after him in full gear, sirens wailing, as they **go to** the far end of the pool where a cake waits.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink}, and the ice cracks. Up shoots a *hillock*, then on top of it a *mountain*, then another, stacking into one **high mountain** that pokes the clouds. She does her poses on the summit while skaters spiral up the **high mountain** like a helter-skelter.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Piazza} juggles books while a stern *scholar* grades her with a red pen. She throws seven, then nine, then the scholar's spectacles too. He writes '**Excellent**!' on her forehead and faints. The crowd agrees: **excellent**.

The {Tsar} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} orders a *boat* hauled up for a voyage among the clouds. Inside its hull he builds a cosy *barn* full of hay as his royal **cabin**. Chickens peck around his throne. He insists it is the finest **cabin** in any airship.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Dunes}, and every *standing person* in the sand turns into a *handsome man* with perfect hair. She juggles mirrors so they can admire how **handsome** they are. The sand gets in their teeth, but they stay **handsome** anyway.

The {Jockey} gallops into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} and piles up *soil* in a corner. He plants a red *stop sign* on top: 'This is the **site** of my new stable.' The bees buzz angrily at the building **site**, and the horse eats the stop sign.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and finds an enormous *dragon* crammed into a garden *shed*. It is so **huge** that its tail pokes out of the window and its nose out of the chimney. The Pirate tries to steal its gold, but the **huge** beast sneezes him back down the stairs.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} tree house drags a *plough* round and round an old stone *well*. Clods of earth fly up as she **ploughs** a perfect circle, and parrots plant seeds behind her. Monkeys line up to **plough** too, pulling her along like a pony.

The {Robot} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *money changer* sits filing *gold coins* on a whetstone. Each coin comes out razor **sharp**, and he flings them like throwing stars. One slices the Robot's antenna clean off. 'Too **sharp**!' it beeps, as magazines flutter to the floor in neat ribbons.

The {Firefighter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} and has a *chance meeting* with a gorilla whose trousers have split. She pulls out a reel of *silk thread* and stitches the **seam** shut, right there on a branch. The gorilla checks the **seam**, nods, and swings away, perfectly decent again.

The {Hunter} sits in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room} next to a *busy mother* juggling five toddlers. He promised to help and didn't. Now his *standing heart* droops like a wilted flower and sighs loudly. He **regrets** it so much that he sobs into his hat. 'I **regret** everything,' he moans, as a toddler steals his boots.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} rolls out a long *road* of red carpet down the side of the building. *Sparkle* flies from her fingers, spelling out letters in the air: 'You are **invited**!' Pigeons, clouds and a passing balloon all accept. She **invites** the moon too, which arrives late.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, where a tiny *king* rings a bell before each round: **ting-a-ling**! A *herald* in tights shouts the name of each fighter. The king gets so excited that he rings and rings, **ting-a-ling**, until the boxers are dancing instead of punching.

The {Wizard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house holding a *standing heart* in a jar. A single *sparrow* lands on it and sings. The Wizard has cast spells on thousands of birds, but this is the **only** one he loves. He feeds it his **only** biscuit and declares it the one and **only** queen of the lake.

The {Chef} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} waving a *chipped axe*. 'Who broke my axe?' he roars, and starts to **blame** the bees one by one, pointing the jagged blade at each. The bees **blame** the queen, the queen **blames** the honey, and the honey just drips silently.

The {Jockey} rides up the {Staircase} of the {Island} lighthouse and finds a tiny *dwelling* tucked under each step. He knocks: crabs live in one, turtles in another, a grumpy seagull in a third. He hammers up a grand sign: 'Private **Residence**'. Now every step is someone's **residence**, and his horse needs permission to climb.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} is pouring *water drops* into a teapot when a *blushing* customer asks for more tea. She **adds** a drop. And another. She keeps **adding** until the teapot overflows, coins float away, and the blushing customer turns even redder.

The {Wizard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} hears there is treasure below. A *helping hand* grabs a magic *shovel* and starts to **dig** straight through the roof tiles. It **digs** through the sauna, the massage room and the hot tub, until steam shoots up like a geyser and the treasure turns out to be a rubber duck.

The {Hunter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} is freezing. He opens his *mouth* wide and **breathes out** a huge cloud of warm fog, and his *nodding head* bobs with every puff. Each time he **breathes out**, the snow on the roof melts into a little puddle.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} into a *town square* full of fish in wigs. A *small speech bubble* floats from his lips saying 'Not my fault!' He is being sued: a **lawsuit** for splashing. The crab judge bangs her claw, and the **lawsuit** drags on until high tide.

The {Yogi} in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} holds her breath too long and turns blue. A fluffy *sheep* trots in, puffing *steam* out of its nose like a little kettle. It is pure **oxygen**. She breathes it in and floats up, while the sheep pumps out more **oxygen** for the airplanes.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into *water drops* that keep spreading and spreading until they become a **vast** ocean. An *announcer* on a buoy shouts through a megaphone, 'Ladies and gentlemen, the most **vast** sea ever!' The Hunter paddles in circles, unable to see the shore.

The {Yogi} in the {Basement} of the {Museum} sneezes, and a pillow explodes. *Feathers* fill the room like snow, settling on the mummies and the dinosaur bones. She picks up a single **feather** and balances it on her nose, then floats upward on a cloud of **feathers**.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} juggles a gleaming *axe* and a sack of rice. A market woman shouts, 'Is that a full **catty**?' The Juggler chops the rice into exact half-kilo bundles mid-air, each a perfect **catty**, and drops them neatly onto the scales below.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} wearing sunglasses and holding a *wine jug* full of ice cubes. An *announcer* yells, 'Here comes the **coolest** King alive!' He slides across the water on the jug, so **cool** that the pool freezes behind him.

The {Lifeguard} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} into a *palace* made of ice. A greedy *helping hand* slides out, grabbing crowns, candlesticks and golden skates. It **plunders** the treasure room, then skates away. 'Come back!' cries the Lifeguard, but the hand has **plundered** her whistle too.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} watches a *woman* in a pointy hat appear on a broomstick. She is a **witch**, and she makes a *dancer* spin and spin until he turns into a bat. The Yogi stays calm, but the **witch** turns her headstand into a teapot.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and lands on a *small altar* where a *wok* sits sizzling. He knocks it over. Oil spills, the warehouse catches fire, boxes of fireworks explode. A total **disaster**. The Hunter hides under the wok, wondering how one bump started such a **disaster**.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} into a tiny *temple* where a *standing person* holds a tray of honey cakes. 'I **serve** the queen bee,' he says, bowing. The Sheriff takes off his hat and starts to **serve** too, pouring nectar and polishing the throne.

The {Yogi} in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut holds a race for her pets. A *swan* comes **second** after a speedy crab, and it is furious. It curls into the shape of the number 2 and sulks. 'At least you are **second in order**,' the Yogi says, giving it a silver medal.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} as a *woman* blocks her path with a giant concrete *square*. Every time the Firefighter steps left, the woman slides the square left too. She **hinders** every move, so the fire keeps blazing. Finally the Firefighter hoses the square away, still **hindered** by a pile of wet concrete.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} stares at a *clock* stuffed with golden *shells*. Every time it ticks, another shell drops out, and the Tailor grabs it greedily. He wants them all! He stuffs his pockets until his trousers split. Too **greedy**, he topples off the roof, still the most **greedy** man in town.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} into a *tug of war* with a gorilla. A *helping hand* grabs the rope behind him, and he heaves and heaves. He wins! The gorilla pays him in bananas, and the Jockey proudly **earns** a whole bunch. Every rope he wins **earns** him more fruit.

The {Wizard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} waves his wand and *water drops* pour out like a waterfall. A tiny *king* in a rubber ring floats past. The hangar fills to the brim with a glittering **expanse of water**. Planes bob like ducks, and the king rows across the whole **expanse of water** in his crown.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} onto a *lying man* who has fallen asleep on a cushion. Then a cat lifts its leg, and *water* trickles all over him: **urine**! The man leaps up shrieking. The Ninja vanishes in a puff of smoke, holding her nose against the **urine**.

The {Lifeguard} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut into a field of tall *grass*. She swings a *sickle* like a scythe, and every swish releases a white flower: **jasmine**. The whole beach smells of perfume. Soon she wears a crown of **jasmine** and has forgotten all about the swimmers.

The {Shepherd} on the {Staircase} of the {Mint} sees fresh coins drying on a line. He climbs a *stepladder* to **hang** his washing up too, but slips. Now the Shepherd **hangs** upside down from the line between the coins, swinging, while sheep look up and baa.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Casino} holds a *clam* up to his *mouth* to slurp it. It snaps shut on his **lip**! He runs up the stairs shrieking, his **lip** stretched like a rubber band, and gamblers place bets on whether the clam will let go.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} at *dawn* with a giant **writing brush** slung on his back. He dips it in the morning light and paints golden letters across the dark walls. By breakfast the whole mansion glows, and the butler wants his own **writing brush**.

The {Tsar} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} opens a wooden *barn* door and grain pours out like a waterfall. The planes below are buried in wheat. 'My royal **barn** is too small!' he shouts, and orders a second **barn** to be built on top of the first.

The {Gardener} in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room} pushes a wobbly *cart* along the floor while a *crowbar* bends steel rods into a **track**. Patients climb in, and the cart rattles round and round the **track** past the reception desk, scattering magazines.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lake} cottage, tapping his *cane* on a *tree* that grows coins. One **piece**, two **pieces**, three: each tap drops one coin. He collects them one **piece** at a time in his hat, and the hat sneezes them all back out.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} carrying a *dish* scooped from a sparkling *salt flat*. She sprinkles **salt** on every step. The staircase becomes a slide of **salt**, and she rides down it on the dish into the soup pot.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} finds a *sightseer* with a gigantic camera, wandering among cobwebs. He wants to **view** the hidden treasure. The Lifeguard turns on the light, and he gasps: the basement is full of paintings! He **views** every one, flash, flash, flash, until his camera melts.

The {Firefighter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} into a swimming class. A *standing person* waves a *proclamation*: 'I am your **instructor**!' He teaches her to float, to splash, to rescue rubber ducks. She grins: her new **instructor** is very strict, but she passes with a gold star.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Wine Cellar}, wraps a *towel* around his shoulders like a cape, and poses among the barrels. 'How **handsome** am I?' The bottles all clink in agreement. He admires his reflection in every bottle, more **handsome** each time.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} into a *shed* surrounded by a *sprouting field* of green shoots. He waves his wand, and the shed swells into a grand **temple** with golden roofs. Cats line up to pray, and the **temple** bells meow.

The {Firefighter} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair}, where a field of *grass* surrounds a slice of *cut cake*. The **fragrance** is so sweet that the rollercoaster stops mid-air. Riders float toward the smell. The Firefighter sprays her hose, but the **fragrance** only grows stronger.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, where a *lying man* is strapped to *linked rails* on a conveyor belt. He glides past a giant **screen** that shows his own face. The Pirate cuts him free, and the **screen** cheers.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} into a tiny golden *temple*. It is a **Buddhist temple**, and every bee wears a saffron robe and chants quietly. The Sailor bows, strikes the gong, and joins them, humming along in the **Buddhist temple**.

The {Pirate} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and eats a full *moon* pie for breakfast. He grows **fat**. He cuts the next pie in *half*, but eats both halves. He grows so **fat** that he gets stuck in the hangar door, and the planes have to taxi around him.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} hut, where a tiny *king* in a crown is chasing a *goblin*. The goblin crashes into a pane of **glass** and breaks it into a thousand shards. The king is furious and makes the goblin glue every piece of **glass** back.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Museum} and finds a *monkey* trying to stuff a giant *heart* into a teapot. It squeezes, it pushes, it sits on it. How **foolish**! The Yogi shakes her head, but the monkey tries again with a bigger heart, even more **foolish**.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut is kept awake by a *dripping tap*. *Water drops* **drip**, **drip**, **drip** onto her head. She sticks a toothbrush in the tap to stop it, but it only **drips** faster, spraying toothpaste foam.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} finds the drain clogged with rubber ducks and hair. He wrenches open an *unclogged drain* and all the rubbish is **cleared away** in a gurgling whirl. He **clears away** the ducks too, and swimmers cheer.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} stares at a patch of *grass* with a *stern face*. A sign beside it reads '**Xiao** family lawn: keep off'. Mr **Xiao** himself appears and glares at the sheep, who back away very slowly.

The {Zookeeper} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} watches a *woman* waiting in a *queue* of bees for her photo. When it's her turn, she strikes a ridiculous **posture**: one leg in the air, arms like wings. The bees copy her **posture** and fly off in a wobbly line.

The {Chef} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a grain *silo* in the cellar. He reads a single *page* from an old recipe book, and he begins to **tremble**. The silo **trembles** too, and grain pours out in waves.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} hires a *clown* to cheer up the crew. He takes off his make-up and he is so **ugly** that the fish jump out of the water to escape. The Chef hides his face in a pot. Even the boats look away, ashamed to be near something so **ugly**.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} and holds an arm-wrestling contest. The yeti flexes a *strong arm* covered in fur. The Lifeguard's arm is a tiny *pinch* of a thing, thin as a noodle. Clearly **inferior**. The yeti wins in a second and hands her a trophy marked '**Inferior**'.

The {King} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} climbs a *tree* to fetch his crown. He sits on a thin **branch** with a *nodding head*, saying 'Yes, yes, it'll hold.' Crack! The **branch** snaps and he drops onto the roof, crown on his nose.

The {Tsar} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} and bets his crown on roulette. He measures his winnings with his *thumb*: exactly one **inch** of gold. 'Only an **inch**?' he shouts. The croupier measures his crown with a thumb too: also one inch.

The {Robot} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} treehouse has a long *ribbon* tied to its *helping hand*. It starts to **throw** coconuts, bananas, a sleeping sloth, all lassoed and flung into the river. It **throws** so hard that its own head flies off too, spinning on the ribbon.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} hammers a *nail* into a beam and hangs up a giant *eye*. It **stares at** every boxer below without blinking. They freeze mid-punch. The Dentist checks their teeth while the eye keeps **staring at** them.

The {Robot} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} challenges a *clam* to a race. The clam snaps shut on the Robot's *thumb*, and everyone laughs as the Robot hops round squealing. What a **disgrace**! It hides under a towel, its circuits blushing red with **disgrace**.

The {Pirate} in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut finds a *matching pair* of socks for the first time in his life. He holds them up: both striped, both smelly, perfectly **matching**. He weeps with joy and makes his parrot wear a **matching** eye patch.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} with a heavy *toolbox*. A *standing person*, the curator, opens it and gasps: **all** the tools are there. She juggles **all** of them at once: hammer, saw, spanner, drill, while statues applaud.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a loud *quarrel* between twins about which coin is fake. He bites both coins and can **distinguish** them at once: one is chocolate. Now he **distinguishes** every coin in the exchange by taste, and gets a stomach ache.

The {Ghost} slips through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} wailing that it is **hungry**. A *spearman* on guard holds up a *side dish* of dumplings on the tip of his spear. The Ghost gulps them down, but they fall straight through its body. It stays **hungry** forever.

The {Firefighter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} spots a *bug* on the highest *peak* of a tree, buzzing loudly. It is a **bee**, then two, then a thousand. She tries to hose them off, but every **bee** just takes a shower and buzzes happier.

The {Ghost} drifts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} and pops out in front of a *spearman*. His *mouth* drops into a perfect round O: '**Oh**!' The Ghost tries again. '**Oh**!' again. Soon the whole fort is a choir of round mouths going '**Oh**!'

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} shouts into a hollow *moon* she has carried up there. Her voice echoes through its *empty room*, a huge **cavity** in the middle. Fans climb inside the **cavity** and cheer so loudly the moon bounces.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} onto a grey *hillside* where a sad man stands *holding meat*. Rain drizzles on both of them. Everything is **gloomy**: the sky, the meat, his face. The Yogi tries to cheer him up with a headstand, but it only makes the **gloomy** hillside gloomier.

The {King} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} as *water drops* pile up against the reception desk. A *price tag* hangs on the water: 'Very expensive flood'. The dam of chairs strains, groans, and **bursts**! Water rushes out, carrying patients on their magazines. 'It **burst**!' cries the King, surfing past.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Inn} carries a fragile *violet* in a pot across a tightrope. A *small speech bubble* floats over her head: 'Be **careful**...' She inches forward, so **careful** that she doesn't breathe, and sets the flower down without losing a petal.

The {Zookeeper} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} pours *rice* into a *trough* for the elephants. They stampede, slurp and spray rice everywhere. Rice in his ears, on the clouds, on passing birds. Everything is **messy**, and the Zookeeper sighs at the **messy** roof.

The {Gardener} on the {Staircase} of the {Hut} pulls up some *grass* and finds a **kudzu vine** curling up like a *question mark*. It grows a step every second, wrapping around the railings, the door, the Gardener's ankles. By lunch the whole hut is a green question mark of **kudzu vine**.

The {Magician} on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} sprinkles magic dust on a pot of *young crop*. Up pops a green **sprout**, wiggling like a worm. A cat paws it, and it **sprouts** more leaves to tickle the cat's nose.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} tries to make sausages longer than a plane. He stretches the **intestines** from the *moon* down to the ground, drying them in hot *sun rays*. Pilots weave around the **intestines** like a slalom.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and lands next to a *coiled rope*. Her *heart* pounds: it might be a snake! She **avoids** it, tiptoeing in a huge circle around it. All day long she **avoids** every rope, hose and string on the beach.

The {Lifeguard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} slides down a gutter on *water drops*, clutching a stolen *keepsake*. Nobody sees her **slip away**, out the window, across the lawn, gone. The owner chases her, but she has **slipped away** into the night.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut and a **wild goose** splashes down, scattering *water drops* everywhere. It honks so loudly the Hunter drops his bow. The **wild goose** grabs his hat and flies away, honking with laughter.

The {Juggler} on the {Staircase} of the {Ice Rink} skates into a ballroom carrying a golden *wine goblet*. The queen taps her with a sword: 'I give you **noble rank**!' The Juggler bows, slips, and spins around on her new **noble rank** like a figure skater.

The {Pirate} on the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} sees his two *buddies* waving from the back of a huge *bird*. It is a **roc**, with wings as wide as the sky. The **roc** swoops down and plucks the Pirate up too, and they all fly off to find treasure.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} holds out an arm, and a *falconer* releases a giant *bird*. It is an **eagle**, and it lands on her head. The **eagle** shrieks, and the boxers below duck as if punched.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut and finds a sulking *dragon* squashed inside a *bamboo* **cage** no bigger than a birdhouse. It breathes fire, but the bamboo only smokes and smells of toast. She blows her whistle, the bars spring open, and the dragon thanks her by locking her in the **cage** as a joke.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} piles pillows into a little *hillock* and leaps on top, pom-poms high. 'Pyramid!' Her whole squad scrambles up after her, then the backpackers, then a confused goat. The **mound** swells and wobbles until it pokes the clouds, the tallest **mound** of pillows ever built.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} with a *tree* in a pot. She hangs a *jade tablet* from its branches, and it bursts into fragrant **laurel** leaves. She weaves a **laurel** crown for every patient and calls them all champions.

The {Zookeeper} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} waves a *magnet* above the hive, and *water drops* fly up and cling to it. The bees drink from it, plumping up and glowing. He **nourishes** the whole colony this way, and the honey **nourishes** him back.

The {Lifeguard} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café}, an *ear* pressed to a *mortise* in the wooden wall. On the other side, the cats **chat** about tuna, naps and gossip. She joins in, and soon they **chat** for hours, purring through the hole.

The {Dentist} in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} sees a runaway plane rolling toward her. A *helping hand* drags a *roadblock* into its path to **block** it. The plane bounces off. She **blocks** three more planes this way, then goes back to drilling teeth.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} ties a *silk thread* from the top of a *ridge* down to every plane. This is her **guiding principle**: everything follows the thread. The planes taxi along it in single file, obeying the **guiding principle** without a word.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut lifts a *small table* with a giant glowing *moon* balanced on it. Her arm **muscle** bulges, pops and starts to sing. She flexes again, and the **muscle** takes over, juggling the moon by itself while she sips a coconut.

The {Tsar} on the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} trips over spiky seed pods hidden in the *grass*. Every **caltrop** pokes his feet. A *queue* of bees laughs. He orders each **caltrop** to be picked up, one by one, by the bees with tweezers.

The {King} on the {Staircase} of the {Hut} trips over a *scholar* buried in *clutter*: books, bottles, odd socks. In the scholar's hand is an empty snail **shell**. The King blows into the **shell** like a trumpet, and whoosh! All the clutter is sucked inside, scholar included, leaving the stairs spotless.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} and sees a man on a *sickbed* who gives him a terrible *glare*. Across his face runs a long **scar** from a bumper-car crash. The Hunter shows his own **scar**, and they compare scars until the ride closes.

The {Wizard} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} taps a *stone* with his wand, and it hollows into a *rice bowl*. Hungry, he fills the **bowl** with soup, but it keeps growing until he can swim in it. The **bowl** becomes a pool, and he paddles around it with a spoon.

The {Shepherd} on the {Staircase} of the {Ice Rink} hears sheep bleating underground. He finds a dark *cave* in the ice. In the **cave**, his flock is skating in circles. He leads them out, and the **cave** closes with a crunch.

The {Baker} in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} hears a rumble: a runaway *moon* is rolling down the *roadside* toward the planes. He braces his **upper arm**, flexes until his sleeve bursts, and catches it. He kneads the moon like dough against his huge **upper arm** and bakes it into a croissant.

The {Jockey} on the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} lights a blazing *beacon* on a pole and rides his horse straight up a tower of crates. They stand far above everyone, glowing gold. The workers drop their boxes and cheer: '**Outstanding**!' The horse takes a bow, and the Jockey hands out leaflets saying 'Officially **Outstanding**'.

The {Shepherd} on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} finds a golden *shell* worth a fortune and climbs every step to hand it back to the old lady who dropped it. He refuses any reward. The money changers weep and bow: such a **virtuous** man! The shell glows with **virtuous** light, and his sheep get haloes.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} and finds a *minister* yawning beside a *fortune stick*. The stick says '**Lie down**.' The minister **lies down** at once on the stone floor, and the Wizard lies down beside him and snores.

The {Magician} on the {Staircase} of the {Fort} stretches a thin, wobbly **membrane** between the *moon* and the *sunset*, like cling film over the sky. Birds bounce off it. He pokes it with his wand, it wobbles like jelly, and the **membrane** pings him back down the stairs.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut, and an *angry boar* charges at her. She plants her *war club* in the sand and doesn't move a muscle. **Resolute**. The boar skids to a halt, impressed by such a **resolute** stance.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Inn} juggles *gold coins* through flapping rolls of *silk cloth*. Each coin stitches itself in, and the silk turns into shimmering **brocade** covered in golden dragons. The innkeepers grab the **brocade**, wrap themselves up like emperors, and parade through the bar.

The {Cheerleader} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and lets out a gigantic *yawn*. Out tumble IOUs, hundreds of them. She **owes** money to everyone: the banker, the cat, the moon. The banker sends her a bill: she **owes** one yawn for every coin, so she yawns until morning.

The {Lifeguard} sits on the {Front Step} of the {Beach} hut, her *mouth* full of gossip about the *village*. Every sentence ends with a happy little 'li!', a **lively ending** that makes her words skip. The neighbours copy her, and soon the whole village chatters with a **lively ending**.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} misses a step and tumbles into a deep *pit*. At the bottom waits a fat **envelope** with his name on it. Inside, a letter says: 'Please stop falling into pits.' He climbs out grumbling and posts the **envelope** back down the hole.
